descripcion_corta: Community tour and hands-on traditional embroidery workshop with demonstrations of techniques and textile products.

nombre_experiencia: Swimming in the Chunyaxché Lagoon Channels
anfitrion: Muyil Conjunto de Aluxes, S.P.R. de R.I
servicios_incluidos: Boat tour through the Chunyaxché channels, wildlife observation and tasting of traditional food.
descripcion_experiencia: In the Sian Ka’an Biosphere Reserve, this experience crosses Chunyaxché Lagoon and an ancient channel built by the Maya. Accompanied by a local guide, visitors pass through different ecosystems, observe biodiversity and float in a clear freshwater channel. The route then continues towards the Boca Paila estuary, where wildlife such as manatees may be seen, and ends with a Maya meal at the Muyil community centre.
patrimonio_inmaterial: Traditional cooking.
patrimonio_natural: Chunyaxché Lagoon and the diverse plant and animal species that inhabit it.
personas_involucradas: Community members who participate in the project.
se_fomenta: Knowledge of Chunyaxché Lagoon and the diverse plant and animal species that live there.
se_promueve: The use of locally produced organic ingredients and care for the natural environment.

It begins with a primicia ceremony and continues with the identification of seeds and fruits from the milpa according to the season. It also includes a demonstration of henequen fibre extraction and a visit to a xunán kab stingless-bee apiary, where the bee’s cultural, medicinal and everyday importance is explained.

servicios_incluidos: Cultural journey through Yokot’an cuisine, explanation of ingredients and ancestral recipes, and gastronomic tasting.
descripcion_experiencia: Vida Yokot’an presents the relationship between Chontal culture, the Tabasco landscape and traditional cooking. The experience introduces the architecture and materials of a local house, as well as the utensils, ingredients and techniques used in food preparation. Guided by Doña Panchita, a recognised traditional cook, participants help prepare a tasting and learn about the cultural meaning of Yokot’an dishes.

patrimonio_inmaterial: The hosts share the history of ancestral Chontal Maya cuisine, including the ingredients and preparation methods used in the dishes. The gastronomic tasting, featuring ingredients from Tabasco, is the central element of the experience.

The activity includes tastings of cacao, chorote, regional sweets and other traditional Tabasco beverages.

After a safety briefing, visitors navigate the wetland channels to San Pedrito Lagoon while a guide explains the ecological importance of the area. At the lagoon, they take part in the traditional gathering of chocolata clams and, on returning, enjoy minilla empanadas, a seasonal drink and clams roasted over a hearth.

descripcion_experiencia: Venture into maguey country and discover its rich, millennia-old history. Explore the maguey fields, learn ancestral techniques, use Nahuatl words, and savor fresh aguamiel. Learn how maguey honey is made and visit the tinacal to taste pulque and unique spirits, culminating in a delicious traditional meal.

localidad: Buenavista, Tepeyahualco, Lagunilla, Matamoros y Tezoyo
servicios_incluidos: Includes a countryside maize-themed breakfast (two tamales, unlimited blue corn atole and corn coffee, purple corn gelatin, a cottage cheese-filled tlaxcal, three mini blue corn shortbread cookies, and toast with prickly pear jam); a pre-Hispanic earth-blessing ceremony; a biocultural and technical maize interpretive briefing; a traditional harvesting demonstration; interactive recreational traditional games (Rayuela, marbles, lotería, and slingshots); a hands-on blue corn mazapán workshop including transfer, step-by-step masterclass by the local creator, and a keepsake candy; a guided tour of the La Barca de la Fe temple exploring its community history and architecture; a blue corn mazapán sensory history and tasting experience; and an authentic traditional maize-themed lunch prepared by a certified traditional cook featuring ancestral recipes and cultural storytelling.
descripcion_experiencia: Experience agrotourism in Tlaxcala and connect with the land through blue corn. Enjoy a traditional breakfast and a pre-Hispanic ceremony in the cornfield. Learn to make your own artisanal marzipan, be amazed by La Barca de la Fe, and savor an exquisite ancestral meal.
descripcion: Experience agrotourism in Tlaxcala with blue corn. Enjoy a breakfast, a pre-Hispanic ceremony, and make your own marzipan. Be amazed by visiting La Barca de la Fe and finish by savoring an exquisite ancestral meal.
descripcion_corta: Experience agrotourism in Tlaxcala with blue corn. Enjoy a breakfast, a pre-Hispanic ceremony, and make your own marzipan. Be amazed by visiting La Barca de la Fe and finish by savoring an exquisite ancestral meal.

servicios_incluidos: Axolotl Itinerary: parking, restrooms, trailer transportation, tour guide, travel insurance, vermicomposting workshop and materials, “Legend of the Fifth Sun” show, and, if booked, lunch. Firefly Tour Itinerary: parking, restrooms, trailer transportation, tour guide, travel insurance, lodging, meals (dinner and breakfast), and a theoretical and practical pulque workshop.
descripcion_experiencia: Immerse yourself in a magical forest where the legend of the Fifth Sun and the mystical axolotl teach you about self-regeneration and well-being. Take part in a composting workshop, interact with corn and maguey, savor traditional cuisine, and marvel at the fireflies.

descripcion_corta: Experience a magical forest through the legend of the Fifth Sun and the axolotl. Enjoy a composting workshop, interact with corn and maguey, savor the local cuisine, and marvel at the fireflies.

nombre_experiencia: Saberes y Sabores de mi Pueblo
servicios_incluidos: Includes: entrance fees and access to the Firefly Sanctuary (in season), Tecoaque Archaeological Zone and site museum, Nanacamilpa Forest, Nanacamilpa historic center and site museum including a local artisanal ice cream, fresh fruit water, or hot beverage tasting; community ejido fees and protected area access; information, orientation, and local guiding services at each route stop; meals at "El Ranchito" (breakfast and lunch); and one night of lodging at Hacienda San Cayetano.
descripcion_experiencia: Live a unique experience in Tlaxcala connecting history and well-being. Explore the Tecoaque Archaeological Zone and the historic center of Nanacamilpa. Enjoy an exceptional stay at Hacienda San Cayetano, delight in a traditional breakfast in the forest, and relax with a renewing forest bath.

anfitrion: Ana Laura Huerta Ortiz y Fabiola Huerta Ortiz
descripcion_experiencia: Experience the magic of Nanacamilpa with this unforgettable adventure. Savor the local cuisine, including xoletongo and tequexquite, and enjoy an authentic pulque tasting. At dusk, marvel at the spectacular firefly display at Rancho Huertas. End your adventure with a peaceful rest and discover the park’s fascinating history.
descripcion: Experience Nanacamilpa by sampling xoletongo, tequexquite, and authentic pulque. Marvel at the fireflies at dusk at Rancho Huertas, discover fascinating local stories, and relax peacefully in a magical and unforgettable experience.
descripcion_corta: Experience Nanacamilpa by sampling xoletongo, tequexquite, and authentic pulque. Marvel at the fireflies at dusk at Rancho Huertas, discover fascinating local stories, and relax peacefully in a magical and unforgettable experience.

localidad: Tepuente Mpio de Nanacamilpa, Santa Isabel Mixtitlan y San Felipe Sultepec Municipio de Calpulalpan.
servicios_incluidos: Includes three tiered options: the Cultural Introduction (MXN $250.00) covering an interpretive tour, guided aguamiel and pulque tasting, and a metepantle explanation; the Productive Experience (MXN $950.00) adding a traditional local lunch and a maguey fiber workshop (capa de maguey); and the Technical Immersion (MXN $1,650.00) which further includes distillation processes and spirits tasting, an academic briefing on the metepantle, and advanced fiber extraction.
descripcion_experiencia: Discover Nanayork, an immersion in the Santa Isabel–Tepuente Biocultural Corridor. It connects the archaeological past of Tecoaque with the vitality of present-day agriculture through the metepantle system. Take part in the extraction of aguamiel, learn about the pulque process, and enjoy an authentic gastronomic integration in this living territorial classroom.
descripcion: Discover the Santa Isabel–Tepuente Biocultural Corridor. It unites the past of Tecoaque with present-day agriculture, extract aguamiel, learn about pulque, and enjoy authentic gastronomy in this living immersion.
descripcion_corta: Discover the Santa Isabel–Tepuente Biocultural Corridor. It unites the past of Tecoaque with present-day agriculture, extract aguamiel, learn about pulque, and enjoy authentic gastronomy in this living immersion.

descripcion_experiencia: Discover La Quinta Agritourism Farm in Tlaxcala and connect with the earth. Enjoy a homemade breakfast and learn about agroecological farming by harvesting tejocotes and apples. Listen to the heartbeat of the trees, relax with a forest bath, go canoeing, and savor a rustic lunch.
descripcion: Connect with nature at Huerto La Quinta in Tlaxcala. Enjoy a homemade breakfast, harvest tejocotes, and learn about agroecology. Listen to the trees during a forest bath, go canoeing, and treat yourself to a rustic lunch.
descripcion_corta: Connect with nature at Huerto La Quinta in Tlaxcala. Enjoy a homemade breakfast, harvest tejocotes, and learn about agroecology. Listen to the trees during a forest bath, go canoeing, and treat yourself to a rustic lunch.

servicios_incluidos: Includes local day guide, seasonal fruit tasting during the tour, aguamiel and pulque tastings along the route, a guided forest bathing session (shinrin-yoku), breakfast, and lunch.

descripcion_experiencia: Aktun Usil is a high-ceilinged cave whose name refers to the place where painted lines can be seen. Inside are paintings, altars, fragments of vessels, ceramics and other remains associated with Maya culture. Certified local guides lead the visit, interpret the underground landscape and share the site’s stories and legends.
patrimonio_material: Pre-Hispanic paintings on the cave walls, pre-Hispanic carvings of Maya figures and symbols in the cave’s stones, and a striking view of the Puuc region from the highest part of the site.
patrimonio_inmaterial: Maya welcoming ritual for visitors, accompanied by phrases in the Maya language and copal incense.
patrimonio_natural: Reforestation of the trail to the cave with local trees and conservation of the trees and wildlife surrounding the cave entrance.
personas_involucradas: Certified tour guides under NOM-08, maintenance staff, mototaxi drivers transporting visitors to the cave and traditional cooks.
productos_locales: Traditional Yucatecan food available by advance booking.
se_fomenta: The care and conservation of the cave.
se_promueve: Learning about Maya culture.
fuente: Maya World Mexico Tourism Experiences Catalogue, UNESCO / Maya World Mexico Alliance, 2025

patrimonio_inmaterial: Traditional culinary knowledge passed down through generations and the Maya language.

se_promueve: Visitors’ active participation in cooking techniques.

servicios_incluidos: Community tour, visit to the archaeological site and milpa, hammock, embroidery and tortilla workshops, with optional accommodation or camping.

These include a milpa tour explaining local cultivation techniques and a community tour featuring hammock weaving, embroidery and handmade tortillas.
